name: ux-craft
description: Decide how an application's pages, flows, and names should work before styling them. page-structure picks the layout, zones, hierarchy, action placement, and states for one page; user-flow designs the step sequence, confirmations, exits, and post-submit path for one task; ui-naming keeps labels, buttons, navigation, errors, and terminology consistent, with a read-only drift scanner. All three read and extend a project-level UX.md so decisions persist.
